title: Continuized Nesterov Momentum Achieves the $O(\varepsilon^{-7/4})$ Complexity in Smooth Nonconvex Optimization
summary: For first-order optimization of non-convex functions with Lipschitz-continuous gradient and Hessian, the best-known complexity for reaching an $\varepsilon$-approximation of a stationary point is $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-7/4})$. The existing algorithms achieving this bound are based on momentum, but are always complemented with safeguard mechanisms that erase the accumulated momentum if a certain condition is violated.
